verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official MCP server that lets AI assistants interact directly with Trigger.dev projects, so users can operate it through natural language in tools like Claude Code or Cursor. However, the natural-language layer comes from the external assistant, the specific operations exposed are not detailed, and there is no native natural-language interface in the dashboard or CLI. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, documented list of project operations controllable via MCP, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: The Trigger.dev MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server enables AI assistants to interact directly with your Trigger.dev projects.
This lets your AI assistant interact with your agents without writing any code.
The Trigger.dev MCP server includes tools for having conversations with your chat agents directly from AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and others.
